message.content:
## RETAKEN Audit #2 — SLOT PICKER (390px)

### Checklist

**1) Available-slot affordance distinct?** ✅
White pills with a hairline ring read clearly as tappable, and are visibly distinct from the selected teal pill and from faded/disabled states elsewhere. The open affordance is unambiguous.

**2) Selected slot instantly readable?** ✅
09:30 stands out immediately — teal ring + soft teal fill + teal text against the neutral white/gray field. Reachable in one glance and distinguishable from the day-chip selection (black pill) without confusion — different shapes/colors for different selection levels is fine.

**3) Touch size comfortable?** ✅
Slot pills ~44px height, ~16px gaps, consistent rhythm. Day chips and footer button also comfortably sized. No crowding in the 4-column grid.

**4) Footer hint + confirm rhythm?** ✅
Since 09:30 is selected, the unselected hint ("Pick a time to continue") is correctly replaced by the state summary: "₹300 · pay at the clinic" left, "11/24 · 09:30" right, with an active black "Confirm slot" button. Selection → summary → confirm rhythm is coherent.

### Remaining observations (minor, non-blocking)
- "Tomorrow" chip renders faded — presumably a fully-booked day. The faded treatment is applied without strikethrough, so it reads as disabled rather than booked; acceptable, but a "Full" micro-badge would remove any ambiguity.
- Date chips ("11/23", "11/24") mix raw dates with "Today/Tomorrow" labels — cosmetic inconsistency only.

No functional or accessibility defects remain. Prior failure items (available-state styling, selected-state visibility) are resolved.

## Verdict: **PASS** ✅
message.reasoning_content: Audit: available pills white with ring — fine. Selected 09:30 teal — fine. Touch 44px — slots look ~44px. Footer hint: shows "₹300 · pay at the clinic" with date/time on right; hint text "Pick a time to continue" — but slot IS selected (09:30), so hint should be replaced by selection confirmation — actually footer shows "11/24 · 09:30" indicating selection. But spec said hint appears when unselected; here selected so footer shows selection + Confirm button enabled. One defect: "Tomorrow" day chip appears faded/disabled-looking (line-through past slots on other days?). Actually Tomorrow faded with strikethrough? It shows "Tomorrow" greyed — odd since tomorrow isn't past. Hmm, "closed/past slots on other days" — but day chips: Tomorrow looks faded, suggesting whole day unavailable — acceptable. Minor: hint text "Pick a time to continue" not visible even though selected — correct behavior. Verdict PASS.
